scope: Documents-owned atomic retention for RF year-source and register-observation originals

unit.scope: RF independent register plus Documents retention/primitive/adapter

verified_behaviors: Multiple original documents retained per source with deterministic identities; identical replay adds no duplicate references.
Complete metadata differences abort capture under document row lock.
Exact company, original document year, actual status, content SHA and length checked.
Captured original deletion is blocked; concurrent removal waits for the capture lock.
Metadata mismatch causes a SQL transaction error even if the caller catches the exception.
Later transaction failure rolls back earlier retention references.
Capture requires an already active transaction and live accepted owner.
Browser roles and RF direct table reads are denied.
Attached and stored statuses remain unchanged and are admitted only for narrow RF retention references.
Legacy registry API status restriction remains intact.
Rollback preserves original references and deletion protection; migration replay restores exact role memberships.
limitations: Complete RF source/observation append integration tests owned by RF persistence agent and separately bound.
No object-provider lease or external cross-capability freshness claim.
Documents-owned metadata hash retains complete public DocumentRecord with UTC normalization; original bytes verified before transaction and metadata binding rechecked under row lock.
This isolated proof does not establish full RF acceptance, production filing readiness, or archive completeness.
Combined RF append/head retention atomicity is verified separately by the RF persistence test owner.
